mapper.select: /* apiQuickReg.selSysApiTree */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS apiSpcNo ,s.api_nm AS spcNm ,s.ver AS ver ,c.ctgry_nm AS ctgryNm ,d.api_nm AS apiNm ,d.api_path AS apiPath ,d.method_cd AS methodCd FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF d ON d.API_SPC_NO = s.API_SPC_NO LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO WHERE s.SYS_ID = #{sysId} AND s.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY s.API_SPC_NO, c.SORT_ODRG, d.SORT_ODRG

/* apiQuickReg.selTmpltList */ SELECT tmplt_no AS tmpltNo ,tmplt_nm AS tmpltNm ,tmplt_desc AS tmpltDesc ,api_class AS apiClass ,mth_type_cd AS mthTypeCd ,cnt_type_cd AS cntTypeCd ,path_pattern AS pathPattern ,dflt_param_json AS dfltParamJson ,dflt_field_json AS dfltFieldJson ,sort_odrg AS sortOdrg FROM KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, TMPLT_NO

/* apiQuickReg.selTmpltMngList */ SELECT tmplt_no AS tmpltNo ,tmplt_nm AS tmpltNm ,tmplt_desc AS tmpltDesc ,api_class AS apiClass ,mth_type_cd AS mthTypeCd ,cnt_type_cd AS cntTypeCd ,path_pattern AS pathPattern ,dflt_param_json AS dfltParamJson ,dflt_field_json AS dfltFieldJson ,tmplt_yaml AS tmpltYaml ,sort_odrg AS sortOdrg ,use_yn AS useYn FROM KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, TMPLT_NO
mapper.update: /* apiQuickReg.delTmplt */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE TMPLT_NO = #{tmpltNo}::integer
mapper.select: /* apiQuickReg.selTmpltDetail */ SELECT tmplt_no AS tmpltNo ,tmplt_nm AS tmpltNm ,tmplt_desc AS tmpltDesc ,api_class AS apiClass ,mth_type_cd AS mthTypeCd ,cnt_type_cd AS cntTypeCd ,path_pattern AS pathPattern ,dflt_param_json AS dfltParamJson ,dflt_field_json AS dfltFieldJson ,tmplt_yaml AS tmpltYaml ,sort_odrg AS sortOdrg ,use_yn AS useYn FROM KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT WHERE TMPLT_NO = #{tmpltNo}::integer
